text: A particle P of mass 0.1 kg is attached to one end of a light elastic string of natural length 0.4 m and
modulus of elasticity 12 N. The other end of the string is attached to a fixed point O on a smooth
horizontal surface. P moves on the surface in a horizontal circle with centre O and radius 0.6 m.
